# About the original exhibition

Exhibition title: 'while something is happening here, something else is happening there ; works 1988 - 1999' ; Spectrum - Internationaler Preis für Fotografie der Stiftung Niedersachsen 

Location: 

Sprengel-Museum Hannover, 26.9.1999 - 2.1.2000.

Staatliche Kunstsammlungen Dresden, Gemäldegalerie Neue Meister, 15.1. - 2.4.2000. 

Sprengel Museum website: [https://www.sprengel-museum.de/ausstellungen/archiv](https://www.sprengel-museum.de/ausstellungen/archiv)

The sum of what is currently publicly available about the artworks in the exhibition.

Sourced from OCR-processed exhibition catalogue held by HsH Library.

Exhibition information (DNB publication record) is included for reference. [https://d-nb.info/957409494](https://d-nb.info/957409494) ISBN [3-88375-396-3](https://www.tib.eu/de/suchen/id/gwlb:302796398?cHash=d9b2700b8cf3934df61d65f43f2e6278).

# Introduction

## Workflows

Workflows can be from active curating project or retrospective documentation of past exhibitions.

### Active projects workflow

Enter data manually into Wikidata, see: Curators' Guide 

### Retrospective workflow

#### OCR Workflow

```text
Book > OCR > Dataset > Wikidata > Publication > Data deposit (PIDs)   
```

This is the minimal Linked Open Exhibition process: a source book is converted through OCR into a FAIR dataset, then structured data is published to Wikidata and rendered as a Quarto publication.

# Example Notebooks

The computational workflow is documented in the notebook set:

- [Exhibition data](notebooks/01-exhibition.ipynb)
- [Artwork data](notebooks/02-artworks.ipynb)

## The prototype

The OCR is a R&D LLM processed experiment by Chloë Farr in cooperation with Computational Publishing Service NFDI4Culture @ TIB Open Science Lab with HsH. 

This prototype made by Simon Worthington as part of [Linked Open Exhibition](https://nfdi4culture.github.io/linked-open-exhibition/), an experimental prototype pipeline for publishing art exhibition data as Linked Open Data (LOD). It was created with students of the Bachelor of Arts Information Management at Hochschule Hannover in the course [BIM-126-02 Data Science](https://www.hs-hannover.de/studium/studienangebot/bachelor/information-management/) (SoSe 2026). See Wikiversity link for teaching materials. [https://en.wikiversity.org/wiki/BIM-126-02-Data-Science-Linked-Open-Exhibition](https://en.wikiversity.org/wiki/BIM-126-02-Data-Science-Linked-Open-Exhibition) (EN/DE).
